name: Oil Explosion
disable: DC 25 Survival check (trained) or DC 23 Crafting check to neutralize the oil without setting it alight

items.name: Explode
items.text:
Trigger An open flame is brought into area A4

---

Effect The oil on the walls explodes, dealing 4d8+10 fire damage to all creatures and objects in areas A4 and A3(DC 21 basic Reflex save).

text: The flammable oil catches flame and explodes, burning up in a ball of fire.
